model: BKN230-24-MOD fire damper communication and power unit
applies_to: Belimo BKN230-24-MOD unit that powers and networks one motorised fire damper actuator (BF24..-ST, BFN24..-ST, BFL24..-ST).
summary: The BKN230-24-MOD plugs into AC 230 V, feeds DC 24 V to one fire damper actuator and puts it on BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU (chosen by DIP switch). A smoke detector can be wired straight to it. The BMS opens and closes the damper through MO 1 and reads position, power use and three status objects for actuator faults, device faults and smoke/temperature trips.
notes: The device instance is AV 121 OffsetDeviceID (default 1000) plus the DIP-switch MAC address; it can't be written through the Device object.
If a smoke or temperature alarm trips, the damper moves to its safety position (closed) on its own.
MO 1 shows Overridden while the local test button is active and Out of service while terminals 1 and 4 are bridged for local control.
The same document also has a Modbus RTU register map; only the BACnet objects are listed here.
Object names for AI 130 and AI 131 wrap onto two lines in the table; they are given here without the break.

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and baud by DIP switch, then command the damper with MO 1 (Open/Close) and read AI 1 for position. Map BI 101 as the general alarm and MI 111 for smoke or temperature trips. If AV 130 is non-zero, keep rewriting MO 1 within the timeout.

minimum_points.name: StatusTripping
minimum_points.why: Smoke detector or temperature sensor tripped

integration.enable: With no command or no bus connected, the damper stays in its safety position. A wire bridge between terminals 1 and 4 opens it locally without a BMS.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 BusWatchdog (default 300 s, 0 = off) watches writes to MO 1. If MO 1 isn't rewritten in time, its priority array is cleared and the relinquish default applies; MI 110 shows BusWatchdog triggered.
setup: DIP switches set baud (9600-76800), termination, BACnet or Modbus, and the MS/TP MAC address 0-127.
gotchas: Actuator, device and tripping faults (except a bus watchdog trip) latch until reset with MV 120 = 4 or the test button.
After local override (terminals 1+4), a stored smoke detector fault must be reset with the test button before the damper runs.

source.title: BKN230-24-MOD technical data sheet (Communication and power supply unit for motorised fire dampers)
